2. Countable or Uncountable?

Tap a food card (or drag it), then select a basket. Some foods can be counted; others need words like some or a glass of.

Countable: an egg → two eggs; a biscuit → three biscuits. Uncountable: milk, rice, meat, pasta, popcorn, juice. We do not use a/an with these as quantities of food.
